en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small pavilion-like building in a landscaped park or garden. The one‑story structure has a central octagonal or polygonal section with a mansard-style roof topped by decorative reliefs, flanked by arcaded wings on both sides. Wide staircases lead up to the entrances, and a curved driveway approaches the front. Tall deciduous trees frame and partially obscure the building, giving a secluded, scenic impression. No legible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.
